newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens spin-offs last resort -labour chief.
newsitem.headline: Siemens spin-offs last resort -labour chief.

text.p: A key labour leader at Siemens AG said the German electronics giant should spin off subsidiaries only as a last resort.

In an interview with company magazine Siemens Welt published on Monday, works council chairman Ralf Heckmann, who also sits on Siemens supervisory board, said internal solutions should be found whenever possible for the problems faced by troubled divisions.

Siemens has been selling off unprofitable units as part of a broad, cost-cutting restructuring, but the sell-offs are acceptable only if the alternative is to shut the units down, resulting in more job losses, he said.
Such spin-offs often result in pay cuts of up to 30 percent for affected workers, Heckmann said.
"The new companies must have a future. And they can only have one if they can operate under market conditions," he said.
